claims.content: Allow the operator to acknowledge an alarm and have the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.

goal.raw_text: Allow the operator to acknowledge an alarm and have the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.

claims.content: Operator
The device has one or more Alarm Criteria.
An alarm condition exists for the device and the device status is updated to indicate an alarm.
The GUI indicates the alarm status for the affected device.
The Alarm Acknowledgment/Silencing Screen is provided.

When the status received from a device sensor is checked against alarm conditions for that device sensor and updated to indicate an alarm, the GUI issues an audible alarm and displays an alarm icon different from the okay status for that device.

trigger.raw_text: When the status received from a device sensor is checked against alarm conditions for that device sensor and updated to indicate an alarm, the GUI issues an audible alarm and displays an alarm icon different from the okay status for that device.

claims.content: The GUI provides an Alarm Acknowledgment/Silencing Screen.
The Operator acknowledges the alarm through the GUI.
The Operator has the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.
2a. After acknowledging the alarm, the Operator may choose to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds.
2b. After acknowledging the alarm, the Operator may choose to silence the audible portion of the alarm permanently for that device only.
E1. If the alarm condition is removed before the operator acknowledges it, the GUI shall automatically change the alarm icon to the normal status icon; exit this use case.
The operator has acknowledged the alarm.
If the operator chose to silence the audible portion of the alarm, it has been silenced for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.
